patterns.rule: Every color token is an HSL triplet stored as a bare CSS custom property (e.g. --primary: 0 0% 9%) and consumed through hsl(var(--name)) — never a hex literal in a component.

Each semantic color comes in a base/foreground pair (--primary and --primary-foreground, --card and --card-foreground, etc.) so text on a colored surface always has a matching, contrast-checked counterpart instead of being picked ad hoc per component.

Exactly one --radius value is declared; every other radius (lg/md/sm) is derived from it by subtraction (radius-md = radius - 2px, radius-sm = radius - 4px) so corner rounding stays consistent across every component without repeating a value.

Dark mode redefines the same token names under a .dark class selector rather than introducing separate dark-prefixed tokens — a component never branches on light/dark itself, it just always reads --background, --foreground, etc.
Interactive controls (button, input, select, checkbox) always render with a visible border or fill and a border-radius from the radius scale — never the unstyled browser default control.
